DiffItem.description:
A :class:`DiffEntry` that serialises its ``from_`` field as ``from``
(the contract's JSON name) even without ``by_alias=True``, which is how the
tool envelope dumps results.
DiffItem.title: DiffItem

changes.description: The musical diff as separate Spanish sentences (one bullet each).
changes.title: Changes

diff.description: Changed fields; ID-based song.yaml paths (chops.c1.warp.pitch_semitones, tracks.drums.pattern.lanes.kick.steps, tracks.<id>.clips[<i>], fx[<i>] for id-less fx).
diff.title: Diff

identical.description: True when the two songs have no structural difference.
identical.title: Identical

metrics_delta.description: Spanish phrases on how the metrics moved; empty unless both versions have a metrics.json.
metrics_delta.title: Metrics Delta
